Golden UDM mapping — deterministic from canonical fields (no AI).

add.name: metadata.product_name
add.value: (product) != null && String(product) != 'undefined' && String(product) != 'null' && String(product) != '-' && String(product) != '' ? (product) : undefined

add.value: (src_ip) != null && String(src_ip) != 'undefined' && String(src_ip) != 'null' && String(src_ip) != '-' && String(src_ip) != '' ? (src_ip) : undefined

add.value: (src_user || user) != null && String(src_user || user) != 'undefined' && String(src_user || user) != 'null' && String(src_user || user) != '-' && String(src_user || user) != '' ? (src_user || user) : undefined
